A promoter sees a read-only balance sheet across every school, a school admin manages students & expenses for one school, finance staff can view and print all payslips for one school, and a teacher only ever sees their own payslips.

landingPage.badge: Built for payroll teams serving multiple clients
landingPage.heroTitle: One desk to run payroll for every client you serve
landingPage.heroDescription: Design your own payslip fields, group employees by department, generate payslips automatically, and deliver them by email or WhatsApp — all from one clean, multi-client workspace.
landingPage.feature1Description: Switch between client workspaces in one click — each with its own employees, departments, currency and pay day.
landingPage.feature2Description: Add earnings, deductions and info fields as fixed amounts, percentages, or per-employee values — scoped to specific departments if you like.
landingPage.feature3Description: Organise employees into departments with heads, headcounts and live payroll totals for each team.
landingPage.feature4Description: Pick a pay period and generate draft payslips for every active employee, calculated automatically from your field designer.
landingPage.feature5Description: Send payslips individually or all at once, by email and WhatsApp, and track delivery status per employee.
landingPage.feature6Description: Every workspace is saved to your own account and backed by a real database — sign in from anywhere to pick up where you left off.
landingPage.ctaTitle: Ready to simplify payroll for every client you run?
landingPage.ctaDescription: Access is by invite only — your administrator adds you and you're in.
landingPage.footer: © {year} Payroll Desk. Built for teams running payroll for multiple clients.
